q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?
answer:
Net sales did not drop yesterday — they rose to ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13 from ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 (+127%), so the business saw a strong uplift, not a decline.

- Key numbers (2026-10-13 vs 2026-10-12): Net sales ₹91,220 ← ₹40,119; Orders 45 ← 26 (+73%); Net AOV ₹2,694 ← ₹2,116 (+31%); Ad spend ₹50,440 ← ₹38,661 (+30%); Discounts ₹5,173 ← ₹1,553 (+233%).  
- What moved this change: the increase is explained mainly by more orders (≈66% of the uplift) and a higher AOV (≈34%); by platform, Meta accounted for the largest share of the lift (about 81% of the change).  
- Certainty & note: these are order-date figures for the default brand (Tilting Heads). Today's data was processed through 09:43 IST refreshes; tax lines failed to fetch but do not change the sales totals.
